answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to post a refundable bond of 5,000 POA before it may trade, like a deposit on a wharf berth. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must lock 5,000,000 POA up front — a ledge of capital that dwarfs any profit from fake attestations. Misbehaving agents lose the bond, so honest work pays and the opal of reputation stays tied to one costly, verifiable identity.
